ruleDefinitions.name: Interesting Service Enumeration Via Sc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the enumeration and query of interesting and in some cases sensitive services on the system via "sc.exe".
Attackers often try to enumerate the services currently running on a system in order to find different attack vectors.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "sc\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*query.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*termservice.*"))
